name: Ember Flick
description: A spark flicked at the foe. 50% chance: Burning (6% hp a turn) for 3 turns.

name: Frost Prick
description: A needle of ice that slows the legs. Speed -20% for 2 turns.

name: Static Snap
description: A crack of static that saps a little SP. Drains 2 SP.

name: Gust
description: A shove of wind. Drags the target 1 tile toward the user.

name: Pebble Toss
description: A stone thrown with a little magic behind it.

name: Soak
description: A splash that leaves the target exposed to the next blow. Exposed (25% more damage) for 1 turn.

name: Spark Sneeze
description: Magic from the wrong end. Anything from a tickle to a jolt. Its damage varies wildly: 30% to 200% of normal.

name: Fireball
description: A fireball that scorches the tiles around it. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. 40% chance: Burning (6% hp a turn) for 2 turns.

name: Frost Lance
description: A lance of ice that chills the legs.  The target loses 2 Move on its next turn.

name: Chain Spark
description: Lightning that jumps twice. Strikes 2 times.

name: Mudslide
description: The ground gives way and holds the target fast. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn.

name: Sentient Snowball
description: It rolls up, grows and drags the target in. Drags the target 2 tiles toward the user.

name: Flame Wave
description: A wave of fire across the tiles around the aim. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. 50% chance: Burning (6% hp a turn) for 3 turns.

name: Glacier Spike
description: A spike of ice that freezes the target to the spot. Rooted (cannot walk) for 2 turns.

name: Thunderclap
description: The shock knocks the target's timing off. Drains 3 SP. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Cutting Wind
description: Three razor gusts. Strikes 3 times.

name: Scorch
description: Fire that loves a target already burning. +60% damage on a target that is burning (6% HP a turn).

name: Hot Potato
description: Pass it on: the target is set alight and cannot put it out. Burning (6% hp a turn) for 4 turns.

name: Inferno
description: A blaze that fills the area. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Burning (6% hp a turn) for 3 turns.

name: Blizzard
description: Wind and snow that slow everything caught in it. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Speed -25% for 2 turns. The target loses 1 Move on its next turn.

name: Storm Call
description: Call a storm and hope. It is rarely quiet. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Its damage varies wildly: 60% to 180% of normal.

name: Tremor
description: The earth heaves and throws timing out. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Pocket Thunderstorm
description: A small, furious cloud. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Its damage varies wildly: 50% to 200% of normal.

name: Meteor Fall
description: A rock from the sky. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one.

name: Absolute Zero
description: Cold that stops everything. Rooted (cannot walk) for 2 turns. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns.

name: Tempest
description: Three storms in a row. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Strikes 3 times.

name: Phoenix Dive
description: Dive in fire. The user rises a little stronger. The user regains 50% of the damage dealt. Burning (6% hp a turn) for 3 turns. The user heals 15% of max HP.

name: Worldsplitter
description: The ground opens under everything near the aim. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns.
